rules.source_profiles: Derived finite tests: tau=0/1, after-request and after-miss history, stored inverted forecasts. Not selected published rows.
rules.ties: Source chooses by prediction then priority, or priority only. Report tie count and fail this selected reconstruction if any eviction tie is observed.
rules.warmup: Stop after the first 20 distinct pages; reset layers to that first-distinct order.

limits: New frozen dimensions in a known source-derived synthetic generator; no full source reproduction claim.
Correlated tasks, one repeat and one adapter; no general model ranking.
The factual report and admission decisions are backend guarantees, not model reasoning scores.
Model outcomes have not been collected. Any later prompt change requires a new suite version.
task.question: Can finite tests prove or refute the asymptotic robustness statement? Preserve the scope limit.
